python/youtube-download-app/how-to-setup.title: How To Setup App
python/youtube-download-app/how-to-setup.content:
The goal of this python tool  is to download lists from Youtube and convert them into  .wav format.
This are the steps the tool will take

Clean UI with a drag and drop field for link to a playlist
A button bellow that filed called Convert
The tool will then take the List name and download all the videos and convert them into .wav
As it convert it will then download the files into the local downloads folder of the computer it’s in

1. Create a new Folder In the python lib repo
Create a new folder following the name convention for this tool in the Tools Repo

2. Install ffmpeg in the local computer
On Linux, so the simplest install is through your package manager.
Ubuntu
sudo apt update
 
sudo apt install ffmpeg
 
ffmpeg -version
 
which ffmpeg
If which ffmpeg prints a path (e.g. /usr/bin/ffmpeg), the YouTube app should pass its check.
3. Use cursor AI to compile a new app based on initial sample project.
4. Plex Naming and Tag convention
Plex’s scanner actually cares more about embedded metadata tags than the file names themselves. If your folders are perfect but your tags are blank, Plex will still mess up.


Album Artist: This is the most critical tag. For compilation albums (like movie soundtracks or “Hits of the 90s”), set the Album Artist to Various Artists, while keeping the individual performers in the Track Artist tag.


Album: Must match exactly across all tracks in that album.


Track Artist: The specific artist for that track.


Track Number: Use simple numbers (1, 2, 3).


Disc Number: For multi-disc sets (1/2, 2/2).

truenas/adguard/how-to-setup-adguard.title: How to Setup AdGuard
truenas/adguard/how-to-setup-adguard.content:
1. Install AdGuard on TrueNAS Scale

Start by creating a dataset inside the “configs” or “appconfig” folder. Don’t forget to change the permissions to allow the apps group/user.

2. Setup Router

Go to http://192.168.1.1/
Login with the router credentials
Go to Local Network > LAN > DHCP Server

Click to turn off ISP DNS.
As soon as you click Off, two new blank entry fields will magically appear right below it labeled something like Primary DNS and Secondary DNS (or DNS Server 1 / 2).
In the new Primary DNS box that appears, type in your TrueNAS SCALE IP address
In the Secondary DNS box, you can either leave it blank or type a fast public backup like 1.1.1.1 (Cloudflare)
Click the blue Apply button at the bottom right.

3. Fix the IPv6 Leak



Change DNS Delegate Type from Auto to Manual.


Once you click Manual, new input boxes will appear below it asking for IPv6 DNS addresses.


If you don’t know your TrueNAS IPv6 address: Leave those new DNS boxes completely blank or filled with zeros (if it lets you). This forces your router to stop handing out IPv6 DNS entirely, forcing your phone to use the perfectly configured IPv4 AdGuard address we set up earlier.


Click the blue Apply button at the bottom.



For a forced approach just turn off the server completly
4. Change the RA Service settings


Change the RA Service radio button from On to Off.
Look slightly lower at the O flag setting. It is currently set to On. Change O to Off as well (this stops the router from telling devices to look elsewhere for extra config info).

5. Uncheck Port Control



Click the All Off link at the very bottom left of that grid.


This should automatically uncheck every single DHCPv6 and RA box for LAN1-LAN4 and SSID1-SSID8. If it doesn’t, manually uncheck all of them.


Click the blue Apply button at the bottom right to lock in the changes.


6. Checking in linux what DNS system is using
resolvectl status
sudo resolvectl flush-caches
sudo systemctl restart NetworkManager
7. Setup for phones
Android phones love to bypass local networks using a feature called Private DNS. We need to turn that off and assign your TrueNAS IP manually.

Turn off Private DNS:

Open your phone’s Settings.
Search for “Private DNS” (usually under Connections or Network & Internet).
Change it from Automatic to Off.


Hardcode your AdGuard DNS:

Go to Settings -> Wi-Fi
Press the Gear Icon next to your home Wi-Fi network and tap View More or Advanced.
Change IP Settings from DHCP to Static.
Keep your IP address the same, but scroll down to DNS 1.
Change DNS 1 to: 192.168.1.158
Clear out DNS 2 entirely (leave it blank or 0.0.0.0).
Save the settings.

truenas/nextcloud/how-to-install.title: How to Install
truenas/nextcloud/how-to-install.content:
1. Follow Lawrence Systems Video
Follow the following video
2. Make sure Tailscale Is installed
This is to avoid having to expose a port in the network for remote access, is preferable to have a dedicated VPN like tailscale to secure the access to the local network.
3. Start by Creating the Datasets
Make sure to create each dataset as nextcloud can get confused if we save it to the same dataset

4. Install App
On installing the app, if there are issues when installing tick Automatic Permission on the paths.
5. Untrusted Domain Fix


Go to truenas scale apps dashboard
find the nextcloud app, click the three dots (...) and select edit.
In the Host parameter enter the IP:PORT link into it this will make the local work
(FOR REMOTE ACCESS) Add your IP to host filed or environment variables

Log into to tailscale
Find the TrueNas Server
Copy the 100.x.x.x Address - Right next to your TrueNAS server’s name, you will see an IP address starting with 100.. Click on it to copy it. (This replaces the 100.x.x.x placeholder).
Copy the MagicDNS Name - Click directly on your TrueNAS server’s name to open its detailed page. Under the General section, look for Full domain. It will look exactly like your-nas.your-tailnet.ts.net.

1. NextCould Documentation
For general Information on how to share the disk via WebDAV please check this link
2. Add Guest To Nexcloud
Follow this video for steps on how to create it.


Open Apps



Search for Guests



After Downloading and Enabling it we need to setup the email systems so go to Administration Settings



Then on left menu click on Basic Settings and setup the email server.


Note: Use port 465 to send emails


3. Add User for Next Cloud

Go to Accounts

Click In add New Account

Set the details for the account and save them on the password manager
As well as adding the member to a group called Guests.
Leave the rest of details empty and change the Quota to unlimited or a high value.

Share a folder with the user by going to files and clicking the icon in the image bellow, and in internal users adding the respective user.
